correctness.rationale: At rho=1 the linearization has exactly one center direction. Substitution of the symmetry-compatible center graph gives the displayed coefficients. With W=xi^{-2}, the reduced scalar equation yields W=2ct-(q/c)log t+C_infty+o(1) because the remaining derivative error is O((log t)/t^2), which is integrable. Exact rational checking at sigma=10, beta=8/3 reproduces 15/22 and 609/1936. The claim is explicitly local and does not extrapolate finite computations to global or infinite-time facts.

value.rationale: The primary Lorenz pitchfork is a canonical critical transition. Its cubic decay scale is classical, but the first subleading asymptotic is controlled by a model-specific quintic coefficient. The exact logarithmic coefficient 609/1936 at the standard parameters gives a natural, coordinate-fixed quantitative refinement and sharply distinguishes the classical three-dimensional model from the published five-dimensional extension, which has the same leading cubic scale but a different logarithmic coefficient.
